lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white line segments are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is broader in the anterior region and narrows progressively toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is located on the second line segment from the posterior, branching toward the dorsal ridge. A partial junction is visible on the fourth line from the anterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 4, 11, and 12 from the anterior are discontinuous or truncated. Several segments terminate mid-torso without reaching the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, with highest density in the mid-thigh region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior mid-thigh align to form a semi-horizontal geometric row along the lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white horizontal patches on the lower neck; one white spot on the muzzle between the eyes; dark pigmentation on the interior margins of the pinnae.
